name: Kepler
summary: Shanghai Kepler Robotics Co., Ltd. is a high-tech innovation company focused on the development, production and application ecosystem of general-purpose humanoid robots. It aims to build industry-leading 'blue-collar' humanoid robots that can be deployed in practice. The company targets intelligent manufacturing, warehousing and logistics, specialized industries, research and data collection, providing customized intelligent solutions driven by innovation. It has formed strategic partnerships with several industry leaders, filed more than 30 patent applications in China and abroad, and received more than 10 patent grants. Kepler uses proprietary algorithms to combine predefined humanoid movements with end-to-end autonomous planning and precise control. Its robots feature high-performance GPU boards and a variety of sensors, including vision-only recognition and navigation systems. Their biomimetic construction enables them to handle demanding tasks in a more human-like way, freeing people from repetitive work and hazardous industries while improving productivity and efficiency.
